assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Diagnosis codes I25.10 and R00.2 are documented
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease
The clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring service
The service was denied under CO-50
